hist_case.problem: Blueprint §45a Gate 0 blocks any Body-authority expansion until 7 remediation items close. Founder requested a ChatGPT relay Body on 2026-08-15; live code check found 2/7 items closed, 5 open, including a bare `founder_authority === true` client-supplied boolean in routes/general-browser-agent-routes.js granting full vault/payment authority with zero independent confirmation — named in the source blueprint itself as its most severe adversarial finding.
hist_case.case_text: The relay Body the founder wants needs zero vault/payment authority — it only needs a real Task Authorization Envelope primitive to anchor per-task authorization to the founder's live instruction (never to observed ChatGPT/page text, closing the same prompt-injection gap §46 already names as undefended). services/taloa/task-authorization-envelope.js already exists with a working create() method but has zero real callers anywhere in the repo — confirmed by grep, not assumed. GATE0-001 adds exactly one method, verify(), to that already-built file. This is the single, minimal, already-scoped dependency the relay blueprint (TALOA_CHATGPT_RELAY_AND_CAPSULE_BLUEPRINT_2026-08-15.md) needs — GATE0-002/003/004 (payment-route wiring, per-Body credentials, replay protection) are real but unrelated to communication-only relay and are intentionally not being dispatched in this pass.
ideas: Dispatch only GATE0-001 now, not the full 4-step Gate 0 closure mission — the relay blueprint declares GATE0-001 as its only real dependency.

Acceptance is reachability-checked (scripts/verify-gate0-closure.mjs), not just export presence — GATE0-002_reachable_from_route stays failing until the vault route is separately, deliberately wired, preventing a false-done claim on the part that matters most.
hist_case.opportunity: Closing this one primitive unblocks the founder-requested ChatGPT relay Body without touching the payment/vault route at all, and gives every future Body (Android, macOS perception, this relay) a real authorization anchor instead of another bare boolean.
